caption: Edge
description: Extends the core edge object with labels for categorizing and filtering edges within a graph, and privilege-to-attack mappings for annotating edges with specific permissions and MITRE ATT&CK techniques.
name: edge

labels.description: The list of labels attached to this edge. Labels can be used to categorize, filter, and group edges within a graph.

privilege_attack_info_list.description: The list of privilege-to-attack mappings for this edge. Each entry maps specific permissions (e.g., sts:AssumeRole, s3:GetObject) to the MITRE ATT&CK technique they enable.
